label: qafreeze
mission: Successor of campaign 'freeze' (its report: /beegfs/scratch/user/hdejean/pisco/campaign_freeze/REPORT.md — not written yet; REPORT.json carries the same Settled list). Open at hand-off: nothing — the previous campaign settled every arm. **Question (owner, QUESTION.md; HANDOFF.md:66-70):** campaign freeze froze a compressor that had NEVER seen question-answering training. Can a compressor that HAS had one QA finetune then stay FROZEN while a fresh decoder LoRA is trained on the same rows? That is the case `<MEM>` caching needs: compress a collection once, train only the decoder afterwards. **Arm Q (what is tested):** the reference finetune recipe of 184778 / 184780 with ONE change — it starts from a hybrid init: R's own `compressor/` + `connector.pt` (QA-trained) with R's `decoder_state.pt` replaced by the stage-2 decoder (`expQ/archq3/pt_mm_5M_spread/model/decoder_state.pt`, R's own starting point), run with `+model_config_overrides.freeze_compressor=true`, so only the decoder LoRA trains. The hybrid is assembled by copying R's model dir and swapping that one file — the only route that needs no new code, since `PISCO.from_pretrained` reads exactly `decoder_state.pt`, `compressor/compressor_state.pt`, `connector.pt` and `config.json` (pisco/model.py:1376-1405); the two configs differ only in `connector_out_norm` / its init / the image-processor path (`expQ/ft_mm_4b_184778/model/config.json:11-12,24`), and R's config travels with R's connector.
